title: Polling & Real-Time Data
description: Set up polling for real-time data updates and learn smart strategies for efficient data synchronization.

data.text: Some applications need data that updates continuously—stock prices, live notifications, or collaborative editing. React Query provides built-in polling capabilities that automatically refetch data at specified intervals, keeping your UI in sync with the server.

data.title: When to Use Polling
items: Dashboards showing live metrics or KPIs

data.title: Polling vs WebSockets
data.text: Polling is simpler to implement but less efficient than WebSockets. Use polling when data changes infrequently or when real-time infrastructure is unavailable.

data.caption: Polling lifecycle with React Query
data.definition:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Idle
    Idle --> Fetching: Component mounts
    Fetching --> Success: Data received
    Success --> Waiting: Wait interval
    Waiting --> Fetching: refetchInterval triggers
    Success --> Error: Network failure
    Error --> Waiting: Retry after delay
    Waiting --> [*]: Component unmounts

data.title: Polling with refetchInterval
data.content: The simplest way to poll is to set refetchInterval on a query.

data.title: Background Polling
data.text: refetchIntervalInBackground controls whether polling continues when the user switches tabs. Set it to false to save bandwidth and battery.

data.title: Conditional Polling
data.content: Poll only when the user is viewing the data. Stop polling when the component is hidden or the user navigates away.

data.title: Pause Polling When Hidden
data.content: Use the Page Visibility API to pause polling when the user is not looking.

data.title: Pause with External Control
data.content: Allow users or parent components to control polling state.

data.title: WebSocket + React Query
data.content: Combine WebSockets for push updates with React Query for caching and state management.

items.text: Polling interval is appropriate for data volatility

items.hint: Use enabled flag or visibility API

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Control polling with enabled and refetchIntervalInBackground
Always pause polling when not visible
Choose intervals based on data change frequency
data.takeaway: Real-time data requires balancing freshness with performance. React Query makes it easy to configure smart polling strategies.
